_doc: Dated amnesty for ADRs that predate the mandatory `enforces:` frontmatter contract (#2419 AC-1). scripts/check-adr-enforcement.mjs requires every NUMBERED ADR with status accepted/active to declare a non-empty `enforces:` (a gold-check id or INV-nn) — or to carry an entry here with a FUTURE `expires` and a non-empty `rationale`. The list can only shrink: an entry whose ADR now declares `enforces:`, whose status no longer owes one, or that names no ADR file at all FAILS the gate as prunable. This is the dated-debt discipline of suppressions expiry (INV-31) applied to the ADR corpus. A NEW ADR is expected to declare `enforces:` on the day it lands; adding it here instead is a deliberate, dated, justified exception.
